tech.summary: Nvidia ke co-founder aur CEO Jensen Huang ne 12 November ko istefa de diya — aik alleged Chinese spy se affair aur board investigation ke baad. CFO Colette Kress interim CEO hongi aur Harvey Jones board ke pehle chairman banay. Shares subah taqreeban 12% giray; jumma se ab tak company ki market cap $855 billion se zyada kam ho chuki hai. Huang ne 1993 mein Nvidia banayi thi aur usay $5.88 trillion ki company bana diya — AI boom ka sab se bara faida uthane wali company. Earnings 17 November ko hain.
tech.title: Jensen Huang ne Nvidia chhor di — 33 saal baad CEO ki kursi khaali

tech.summary: Nonprofit groups — Irreplaceable Education Fund, Public Citizen, Heat Initiative aur Alliance for Secure AI — ne San Francisco mein OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta aur SpaceX ki AI division par muqadma kar diya. Mutalba hai ke ChatGPT, Gemini aur Claude jese frontier models ki mazeed development roki jaye. Muqadme mein companies ke apne leaders — Dario Amodei aur Elon Musk — ke warnings ka hawala diya gaya hai ke AI 'tahzeeb ki tabahi' ka sabab ban sakti hai. California ke unfair business practices qanoon ki bunyad par court order manga gaya hai.
tech.title: Nonprofits ne OpenAI, Google, Anthropic par muqadma — frontier AI rokne ka mutalba

tech.summary: Google DeepMind ne 12 November ko Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch kiya — Gemini 4 family ka fast, everyday model, jo coding aur agentic workflows ke liye bana hai. Keemat $1.50 input / $7.50 output per million tokens, 1M-token context, aur Artificial Analysis Index par 51 score — Argon (50) se aage. Gemini app aur Google Search mein sab users ke liye roll out ho raha hai; Carbon aur Argon ab bhi gehri reasoning ke liye hain. Naya Orchestrator feature Antigravity mein models ko aik hi session mein switch karta hai.
tech.title: Google ka Gemini 4 Hydrogen — roz ke agents ke liye tez aur sasta model

tech.summary: Anthropic ka Claude Fable 5.2 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index par 65 score ke saath number 1 par aa gaya — Gemini 4 Carbon (60) se aage. Doosri taraf OpenAI ne apna sab se capable security model GPT-6 Cyber sirf approved customers tak mehdood kar diya — testing mein is ne Firefox mein 81 pehle se namaloom high-severity flaws dhoondhe aur Linux kernel ke khilaf 948 working exploits banaye. Google DeepMind ka Gemini Robotics 2.5 Mercedes-Benz ki live production lines par 96% success rate se parts sort kar raha hai.
tech.title: Claude Fable 5.2 AI rankings mein number 1 — OpenAI ne apna cyber model band kar diya

tech.summary: Das AI labs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Microsoft, Hugging Face, Cohere aur doosron — ne 9 November ko Macron ki Paris Call par dastakhat kiye: frontier models ke liye shutdown mechanisms, bahari testing aur incident sharing ka wada. Lekin US aur China ne sign nahi kiya, aur Google aur Meta bhi bahir rahe — jo is pact ki pohnch ko mehdood karta hai. Commitments voluntary hain — na deadlines, na penalties.
tech.title: Paris Call par OpenAI aur Anthropic ke dastakhat — lekin US, Google aur Meta bahir

tech.summary: Jim Simons ki Renaissance Technologies ne apni Q3 13F filing mein Nvidia ki position taqreeban khatam kar di — June mein $1.42 billion se gir kar September mein sirf $5.3 million. Meta, Amazon, Apple aur Broadcom bhi taqreeban khatam; paanchon mil kar $3.88 billion se $10.6 million reh gaye. Ab sab se bari holding Micron ($1.62bn) hai, AMD $1.21bn ke saath teesre number par, aur SpaceX mein $621 million ki nayi position. Filing 30 September ki snapshot hai — Huang ke istefe se chhe hafte pehle ki.
tech.title: Renaissance ne Nvidia ka 99.7% hissa bech diya — ab Micron sab se bara bet

pakistan.summary: Gilgit-Baltistan ke Ghizer zila mein jumeraat ki shaam aik passenger van Morkah Bridge ke paas se Yasin darya mein gir gayi — 11 afraad jaan-bahaq ho gaye, jin mein aik bacha bhi shaamil hai, aur 2 zakhmi hue. Van Gilgit se Yasin Valley ja rahi thi jab driver ne control kho diya. GB ke Wazir-e-Aala Amjad Hussain ne afsos ka izhar karte hue rescue aur ilaj ke liye behtareen sahulatain dene ki hidayat ki.
pakistan.title: Ghizer mein van darya mein gir gayi — 11 afraad jaan-bahaq, bacha bhi shaamil

pakistan.summary: Balochistan ke Mastung zila mein N-25 highway par Kandawa Post par dhamaka-khez gaari se hamla nakam bana diya gaya — 3 dehshatgard halak hue, jabke 2 shehri shaheed aur kam az kam 13 zakhmi hue; 3 FC ahalkar bhi zakhmi hue. Dhamake se qareebi ghar aur aik masjid ko nuqsan pahuncha. Police ke mutabiq hamla-awar Fitna al-Hindustan se taluq rakhte the; BLA ne zimmedari qabool ki.
pakistan.title: Mastung mein Kandawa post par hamla nakam — 3 dehshatgard halak, 2 shehri shaheed

pakistan.summary: PTI aur powers-that-be ke darmiyan backchannel rabton ne party ko kuch saans di hai — Imran Khan se wakilon ki mulaqat aur un ki do behnon ki rehai ke baad deal ki afwahein phir garam hain. Latif Khosa ke mutabiq mulaqat mein 28th Amendment (naye subay) par bhi guftagu hui. Lekin Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi ne deal ki afwahon ko 'do-teen din ki achhi kahaniyan' kaha — KP mein governor's rule aur Khan ke cases abhi bhi hal talab hain.
pakistan.title: PTI ko saans ka mauqa — backchannel rabte, lekin deal abhi door

pakistan.summary: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi ne jumeraat ko kaha ke naye administrative units ya subon par siyasi jamaatein referendum karwayein — 'yehi is behas ka hal hai'. Unhon ne kaha ke agar awaam kahe ke naye subay nahi banne chahiye to wo 100% un ke saath hain. Naqvi ke mutabiq wo aur Bilawal Bhutto 'taqreeban aik hi page par' hain — dono ne 'reset' ki baat ki hai — jabke PPP ne Sindh mein naye subay ki sakht mukhalfat ki hai.
pakistan.title: Naqvi ka mashwara — naye subon par referendum karwa lo, awaam faisla kare

pakistan.summary: Wazir-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif ne Antalya mein COP31 Leaders Summit mein kaha ke climate-vulnerable mulkon ko grant-based climate finance chahiye — qarz nahi — aur resilience funds mein izafa hona chahiye. Unhon ne 2022 ke sailab (33 million mutasir, $30bn nuqsan) aur August 2025 ke Buner flash floods ka zikr kiya, aur kaha ke Pakistan ne 2 saal mein 20GW se zyada distributed solar laga liya hai; clean sources ab energy mix ka 55% hain. Erdogan se mulaqat mein Islamabad MoU par bhi guftagu hui.
pakistan.title: COP31 par Shehbaz: climate finance grant ho, qarz nahi

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange par jumeraat ko KSE-100 index 1,710 points (0.95%) gir kar 177,374 par band hua — aik din pehle 180,000 paar karne ke baad. Volume 1.07 billion shares aur traded value Rs31.6 billion rahi; market capitalisation Rs19.22 trillion par aa gayi. 316 companies ne nuqsan uthaya jabke sirf 155 mein izafa hua — jummay ko haftay ka aakhri session hai aur investors abhi bhi ehtiyat mein hain.
pakistan.title: PSX mein girawat jaari — KSE-100 1,710 points gir kar 177,374 par
